prompt: Wide 16:9 original atmospheric background for the underground mining area of a side-scrolling 2D pixel-sprite RPG lab, using the enclosed Chasm preview only as a lighting and geology reference. Vast lapis and charcoal cavern, towering blocks of sharply vertical and diagonally tilted strata, haze and a slim distant waterfall on right, an old timber mining trestle high in middle distance, ropes and two tiny warm amber oil lamps, muted bioluminescent indigo growth with just a few cyan crystalline highlights, quiet dark slate low-contrast lower third behind small pixel characters and collision ledges drawn separately. Original composition, hand-painted fantasy environment, muted blues and subtle ochre, lateral point of view, retain legibility. No text, logos, borders, people, creatures, UI, floating game platforms, or textural noise.

references.review: Viewed official mine preview reproduced by Game8; used tilted stratum, underground waterfall, and blue/violet glow.
